name: Paper Lanterns
plainLyrics:
Hold the paper lantern high
Carry it down to the water
Every light we let go
Finds the harbor on its own

When the tide comes up the stair
Silver on the stone
We have no more nights to spare
Than the ones we call our own

Through the fog and through the rain
I have come this far
Paper lanterns burn again
Over every harbor bar

Hold the paper lantern high
Lift the paper lantern high
Let it go to the water
Finds the harbor on its own

Finds the harbor on its own
